title: Tensor with a constant complex over $\mathbf Z$
statement:
Let $X$ be a
quasi-compact and
quasi-separated scheme. For $E\in\Dplus(X_{\Et})$ and
$K\in\Dplus(\mathbf Z)$, the canonical map

$$
\RGamma(X_{\Et},E)\kunotimes{\mathbf Z}K\longrightarrow
\RGamma\bigl(X_{\Et},E\kunotimes{\mathbf Z}\underline{K}\bigr)
$$

is an isomorphism.

proof.text: Fix a cohomological degree n. The bounded-flat approximation gives B supported in [b,N] and a map f:K to Q(B) inducing isomorphisms under degree-n homology of each of the two projection functors.
The bounded-flat comparison makes the projection component at Q(B) invertible. Applying homology preserves this isomorphism.

Use the component equation for the canonical projection natural transformation and its naturality square for f. Homology turns this into a commutative square whose two vertical maps and lower horizontal map are invertible. Cancel the right vertical isomorphism to obtain invertibility of the upper horizontal map. This holds for every integer n; DerivedCategory.isIso_iff concludes that the original projection component is invertible.
